context:
Goal: each repo's page shows its plans on the Status tab.
Problem (goal): PR #1779 fixes the pages of child repos (banchi, q_max, joyous), which is work in other repos and needs your word. It sits open in claude-settings today.
Based on (ruling): R44 (child repos follow claude-settings); your 11:13 CST Nov 13 words that runner 11 owns the child repos (item 704 b).
Departs from: main, where #1779 sits open in claude-settings — a moves the work into each child repo.

options.gain: Each child repo's page is fixed in its own repo, by the session that owns it.
options.how: Runner 11, which already owns the child repos, starts one lane per child repo (banchi, q_max, joyous) to fix its page.
options.label: Runner 11 lanes it in each child repo (recommended)
options.lose: Three more lanes in child repos.

options.how: PR #1779 closes; the blank Status tabs stay.
options.label: Close #1779; leave the child pages as they are
options.lose: Banchi, q_max and joyous keep pages with a blank Status tab.

shown.label: Runner 11 lanes it in each child repo (recommended)
Close #1779; leave the child pages as they are

title: Should the fix for child repos' blank Status tabs (#1779) be done in each child repo, or closed?
why: Work in child repos needs your word.
